findings: Keras script uses Adam, SB batch 256, LB batch 5000, 20 epochs and 25 path points.
Keras script restores the same initial weights and recompiles to reset optimizer accumulators between SB and LB.
Shallow convolutions omit subsample; historical Convolution2D defaults to (1, 1), unlike stride 2 in paper Appendix B.3.
Deep network adds convolutional dropout 0.3/0.4 and dropout before the dense layer.
BN mode 2 uses input-batch statistics in training and testing; the path script evaluates in batches of 5000.
Keras example covers C1-C4 without F1; the PyTorch folder supplies a preliminary VGG11-based example.
